purpose: Resolve fresh source availability and dependence before freezing a powered confirmation of the V26 training-content signal.
data_checks: Author raw schema, source bytes/digest/license; bounded<=100MiB download.
Existing qualified native_input_tokens<=3072; exact old prompt/parser identities. Count only; no new selected cohort.
Candidate ID/normalized question/component question disjoint from TRAIN2048 and both inspected held cohorts.
Candidate supporting paragraph/page not anywhere visible in TRAIN2048 or the inspected held512/255.
Within candidates: report connected components of shared support text/page/component ID, largest component, and deterministic greedy support-independent count. No treatment outcomes.

desired_confirmation.primary: Direct-answer canonical complete EM; selector minus EACH direct control, each seed reported separately.
desired_confirmation.decision: point>=.03 and paired95 lower>0 against both direct controls in two data-order seeds; fresh, fixed outcomes required.
desired_confirmation.power: Planning at true5pp/discordance.15 gives approx95% marginal and>=80% joint four-contrast lower bound. Larger discordance/smaller effects are explicitly not guaranteed.
desired_confirmation.threshold_caveat: At true gain exactly.03, the point>=.03 requirement caps asymptotic marginal pass probability at.5. Do not claim80% power at the decision threshold.
desired_confirmation.fallback: Insufficient clean independent questions does NOT release a smaller underpowered study or weaken source exclusions. Reconsider source/protocol transparently before any outcomes.

limits: This is metadata-only access to authors DEV, not official TEST or a benchmark score.
Human inspection of new question/answer examples is deferred; only aggregate metadata printed.
No annotation quality or pretraining-novelty certification.
Fresh models/recovery/storage and actual evaluation need a separate concrete frozen release.
